flows.name: SD hiring
flows.rate: (AUX("$SD target workforce") - LEVEL("$SD Workforce")) / AUX("$SD adjustment time")

info.description: Headcount that hires (or attrits) toward a target at a fixed adjustment rate -- the textbook first-order goal-seeking structure, (target - Workforce) / adjustment_time -- an exact exponential approach to the target. "SD Reported Workforce" is a DELAY1-smoothed reading of the headcount (a reported figure that lags the real one, e.g. because payroll reports it monthly); it does not feed back into hiring. Needs simulation.sd.
